name: slidev-extensions
description: Installable root for the slidev-extensions tools: npm i -g https://github.com/stn1slv/slidev-extensions/archive/refs/heads/main.tar.gz
_comment: postinstall rather than prepare, and the archive tarball rather than a git spec: npm runs a nested install for a prepare script, and npm 11 installs a global git dependency as a symlink into its temporary clone, which it then deletes. A tarball is copied like any package, and postinstall builds dist/ in place with nothing but Node.
